paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Chalukah, a distinguished man and sage in Rabbi Eliezer’s and Rabbi Yehoshua’s time, is not among those of the Mishnah. I did not find him. But I saw Rabbi Tzadok ben Chalukah, who lived in Rabbi Yose ben Zimra’s time; see his entry.
